capabilities: Render blank lines between paragraphs as larger gaps
Adjust list and task indentation like a rich-text editor
Add controls above Markdown tables and support HTML tables
Insert quote prefixes and line breaks in quotes and callouts
Manage content themes with search, grouping, and import/export
disambiguation: Not a workflow or automation tool despite the name; it is named after its blank-line paragraph-gap feature.
extras: Development is primarily on Windows; macOS, Linux, and mobile support is unverified, and longer documents may have performance issues. A showcase vault with preset settings is downloadable from the release. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed.
intentEvidence: I love Typora's distraction-free experience and Obsidian's wiki links, so I wanted to build an "Obsidian with Typora inside."
motivation: The author loves Typora's distraction-free experience but also Obsidian's wiki links, and wanted to build an "Obsidian with Typora inside."
problem: Obsidian's editing views don't render or handle paragraphs, lists, tables, quotes, and math the way Typora's distraction-free editor does.

relations.evidence: brings some of Typora's features and editing experience to Obsidian

summary: Typora-style editor visuals for Obsidian: paragraph gaps, list indentation, table controls, math previews, and code-block aids.
